name: Initial
description: Cancer workflow begins

name: Patient Profile
description: Age gender demographics and observation metadata

name: Lifestyle and Exposure Assessment
description: Smoking alcohol diet obesity physical activity and UV exposure

name: Concerning Symptoms or Clinical Changes?
description: Select screening or diagnostic path

name: Cancer-Specific Screening
description: Screening where applicable

name: Diagnostic Clinical Encounter
description: Clinical encounter for symptoms or findings

name: Clinical Assessment
description: Assessment of systemic surface and functional changes

name: Suspicious Clinical Finding?
description: Determine whether further investigation is required

name: Routine Monitoring
description: Monitoring when no suspicious finding is identified

name: Diagnostic Work-up
description: Laboratory and imaging assessment

name: Laboratory Assessment
description: CBC CMP CRP and ESR measurements

name: Imaging Assessment
description: Cancer-specific imaging where applicable

name: Suspicious Lesion or Abnormality?
description: Review clinical imaging and laboratory findings

name: Monitor and Reassess
description: Repeat assessment when appropriate

name: Biopsy or Tissue Sampling
description: Tissue sampling where clinically applicable

name: Biopsy Histopathology Assessment
description: Determine histology tumour classification microscopic features and whether malignancy is confirmed

name: Malignancy Confirmed?
description: Pathology confirmation decision

name: Non-Malignant Follow-up
description: Non-cancer follow-up or general care when malignancy is not confirmed

name: Cancer Type Classification
description: Cancer-specific classification

name: Breast Cancer Pathway?
description: Determine whether breast-specific receptor data apply

name: HER2 ER and PR Assessment
description: Breast-specific receptor assessment where applicable

name: Clinical TNM Assessment (cTNM)
description: Pre-treatment clinical assessment of primary tumour regional nodes and distant metastasis using available clinical and diagnostic evidence

name: T - Primary Tumor Assessment
description: Tumor size depth and local extension

name: N - Regional Lymph-Node Extent
description: Cancer-specific regional nodal extent based on location laterality size and/or number where applicable; not node count alone

name: M - Distant Metastasis Assessment
description: Presence or absence of distant spread

name: Distant Metastasis Identified?
description: M1 or M0 branch

name: In Situ Disease?
description: Tis where Stage 0 applies

name: Cancer-Specific Stage Group
description: Combine applicable T N and M categories

name: Stage 0 - In Situ (Where Applicable)
description: Carcinoma in situ without invasion; applicability and definition vary by cancer type

name: Stage I - Cancer-Specific Early Invasive Disease
description: Often limited primary extent without distant metastasis; exact TNM and profile criteria vary by cancer type

name: Stage II - Cancer-Specific Intermediate Extent
description: May reflect greater primary extent and/or limited regional nodal involvement without distant metastasis; exact criteria vary

name: Stage III - Cancer-Specific Locally Advanced or Regional Disease
description: Often greater local extension and/or regional nodal involvement without distant metastasis; exact criteria vary

name: Stage IV - Metastatic Disease
description: Distant or metastatic disease

name: Follow-up and Surveillance
description: Symptoms laboratory tests imaging lifestyle and well-being

name: Progression or New Finding?
description: A progression concern or new finding returns to clinical assessment and diagnostic confirmation before any restaging

name: Module End
description: End of current workflow cycle

name: Family and Hereditary Risk Assessment
description: Assess structured family history, hereditary susceptibility, prior genetic testing and polygenic risk without treating risk as diagnosis

name: Structured Family History
description: Biological relationship; degree; maternal or paternal lineage; cancer type and subtype; age at diagnosis; multiple primary cancers; number affected; age and cause of death; prior genetic testing; known hereditary syndrome

name: Hereditary Evaluation Indicated?
description: Use the cancer pattern, young age at diagnosis, multiple primaries, affected relatives, phenotype and applicable guidance; familial clustering alone does not prove a syndrome

name: Genetic Counselling and Clinical Review
description: Review informed testing, limitations, implications and appropriate cancer-specific interpretation before or with germline evaluation

name: Germline Test and Variant Interpretation
description: Record test performed, gene, variant and clinical classification; a pathogenic germline variant increases susceptibility but does not establish current cancer

name: Hereditary Syndrome Context
description: Hereditary breast and ovarian cancer; Lynch syndrome; familial adenomatous polyposis; Li-Fraumeni syndrome; other phenotype-appropriate tumour-predisposition syndromes

name: Hereditary Gene Context
description: BRCA1; BRCA2; APC; MLH1; MSH2; MSH6; PMS2; TP53; PALB2; PTEN; and other phenotype-appropriate genes

name: Polygenic Risk Score Assessment
description: Multiple common variants combined using weighted genetic effects to estimate relative inherited susceptibility; complementary to, not interchangeable with, family history

name: PRS Interpretation Caution
description: Performance may vary across populations and ancestry groups; require appropriate calibration, prospective validation and evidence of clinical benefit before individual clinical use

name: Integrated Hereditary Risk Context
description: Integrate family pattern, germline findings when available and PRS when appropriate; preserve uncertainty and cancer-specific interpretation

name: Cancer-Associated Infection History
description: Record relevant history of HPV, HBV, HCV, EBV, HTLV-1, Kaposi sarcoma-associated herpesvirus and HIV-related immunosuppression according to cancer and population context

name: Multifactorial Risk Context
description: Inherited variants, acquired alterations, epigenetic change, environmental carcinogens, chronic inflammation, infection, hormonal and metabolic influences can interact over time

name: Integrated Baseline Risk Context
description: Combine hereditary, lifestyle, environmental, infectious and demographic context as risk information—not evidence of current cancer

name: Medical and Screening History
description: Previous cancer; previous biopsy; previous pathology; previous abnormal imaging; previous screening; previous genetic testing; surgical history; chronic conditions; relevant medications and medical exposures

name: Temporal Change Assessment
description: Determine whether findings are new, persistent, previously investigated, recurrent or changing before evaluating current symptoms

name: Risk–Suspicion–Diagnosis Distinction
description: Risk factors indicate susceptibility; clinical findings may create suspicion; diagnosis requires appropriate clinical and diagnostic evidence and often histopathological confirmation for solid tumours

name: Longitudinal Information Context
description: Update family history, exposures, symptoms, laboratory trends, imaging, pathology and disease classification as information changes over time

name: Integrated Clinical Findings
description: Converge general clinical assessment with cancer-specific clinical modules where applicable

name: Integrated Laboratory Findings
description: Converge CBC CMP CRP ESR and relevant trends into one laboratory interpretation

name: Integrated Imaging Findings
description: Converge imaging method lesion characteristics and regional or distant spread findings

name: Integrated Diagnostic Findings
description: Combine clinical laboratory and imaging evidence before deciding whether an abnormality requires tissue diagnosis

name: Weight Loss
description: Unintentional weight loss; amount, duration and progression

name: Persistent Pain
description: Persistent or unexplained pain; site, severity, duration and progression

name: Bleeding Assessment
description: Unexplained bleeding; site, frequency, duration and progression

name: Breast Biomarker Profile Integration
description: Converge HER2 ER and PR results for breast-specific stage/profile interpretation and treatment planning

name: Which Staging System Applies?
description: Select TNM or an applicable cancer-specific alternative based on cancer type and current classification guidance

name: Does the Applicable System Map M1 to Stage IV?
description: Apply only the selected cancer-specific staging definition; do not assume a universal mapping

name: Other Cancer-Specific Stage Result
description: Record the stage or extent defined by the applicable cancer-specific system when a direct M1 to Stage IV mapping is not appropriate

name: Applicable Cancer Stage Result
description: Converge the result from TNM or the selected cancer-specific alternative staging system

name: Stage and Tumour Profile Integration
description: Integrate applicable stage grade histology biomarkers and molecular or genetic profile without treating stage as individual prognosis

name: Biopsy Details
description: Biopsy method; date; anatomical site; specimen

name: Breast-Specific Clinical Signs (Where Applicable)
description: Cancer-specific module: lump or thickening; location; size; skin or shape change; nipple change; discharge; pain; duration; progression

name: CBC Assessment
description: Hemoglobin; RBC; WBC; platelets; RBC-related indices; WBC differential

name: CMP Assessment
description: ALP; AST; ALT; calcium; albumin; bilirubin; other metabolic measurements

name: Estrogen Receptor
description: ER staining result; positive percentage; final ER status

name: HER2 Assessment
description: IHC result; FISH result; ERBB2 signal; ratio; final HER2 status

name: Imaging Method
description: Mammography; CT; MRI; ultrasound or other applicable imaging

name: Inflammation Assessment
description: CRP and ESR; previous value; current value; date and trend

name: Lesion Characteristics
description: Presence; location; size; shape; margins; count

name: Progesterone Receptor
description: PR staining result; positive percentage; final PR status

name: Spread Assessment
description: Regional lymph-node findings and distant findings

name: Validated PRS Appropriate and Available?
description: Use only when the score is relevant, appropriately calibrated and validated for the population and intended clinical context

name: Physical Activity
description: Frequency; duration; intensity; occupational and recreational activity; and sedentary time

name: Alcohol Consumption
description: Alcohol type; quantity; frequency; duration; and current versus previous consumption

name: Diet and Nutrition
description: Overall dietary pattern; fruit and vegetables; fibre; processed foods; red meat; and overall nutritional quality

name: Obesity and Body Weight
description: BMI; body weight; waist measurement; overweight or obesity status; weight history

name: Red and Processed Meat
description: Red meat and processed meat consumption; servings and quantity per week

name: Smoking and Tobacco
description: Current and previous smoking; initiation age; duration; quantity; cessation; second-hand exposure; smokeless tobacco; cumulative exposure in pack-years (packs/day × years)

name: Ultraviolet Exposure
description: Sun exposure; UV exposure; occupation; tanning exposure; duration and protection

name: Clinical TNM cTNM
description: Clinical stage established before definitive treatment using clinical examination and diagnostic investigations

name: M0
description: No distant metastasis identified

name: M1
description: Distant metastasis is present

name: N0
description: No regional lymph-node metastasis

name: N1 through N3
description: Increasing regional lymph-node involvement; exact definitions depend on cancer type

name: Cancer Staging Overview
description: Cancer staging describes the anatomical extent of disease using clinical and pathological information

name: Pathological TNM pTNM
description: Pathological TNM based on clinical information plus adequate surgical and histopathological findings; available only when applicable

name: T1 through T4
description: Increasing tumour size or increasing local extent; exact definitions depend on cancer type

name: Tis Carcinoma In Situ
description: Carcinoma in situ without invasion of surrounding tissues

name: TNM Category Integration
description: Combine the assessed T N and M categories before cancer-specific stage grouping

name: Lung Cancer Risk Inputs
description: Use recorded gender smoking status and quit-smoking age when applicable

name: Gender for Lung Risk Model
description: Select the sex-specific probability branch recorded in the source model

name: Female Smoking Status
description: Current smoker former smoker or never smoker

name: Male Smoking Status
description: Current smoker former smoker or never smoker

name: Female Lung Risk Calculation
description: Apply female smoking status and quit-smoking age when applicable

name: Quit-Smoking Age - Male Branch
description: Record cessation age for former smokers or mark it unavailable

name: Male Lung Risk Calculation
description: Apply male smoking status and quit-smoking age when applicable

name: Female Probability Values
description: Smoker 0.185 (18.5%); quit smoker 0.026 (2.6%); nonsmoker 0.004 (0.4%)

name: Lung-Risk Result Action?
description: Use the source-model result with applicable screening guidance and clinical judgement; no universal numerical cutoff is assumed

name: Male Probability Values
description: Smoker 0.244 (24.4%); quit smoker 0.055 (5.5%); nonsmoker value unavailable in source

name: Quit-Smoking Age - Female Branch
description: Record cessation age for former smokers or mark it unavailable

name: Recorded TNM Clinical Fields
description: Primary tumour size/local extension; involved-node count; micro/macrometastasis; metastasis location

name: Additional Activity Finding
description: Initially inactive men increasing activity: about 13% lower reported risk

name: UV Reported Value
description: About 90% of skin cancers attributed to UV exposure in the cited source

name: Laryngeal Smoking Value
description: Smoking-attributable fraction exceeds 50% in the cited analysis

name: Combined Lifestyle Impact
description: About 18% of cancer cases and 16% of cancer deaths in one reviewed estimate

name: Environmental Exposures
description: Air pollution; occupational chemicals; industrial exposure; dust and fibres; radiation; ultraviolet exposure; workplace conditions; duration and intensity

name: Food Evidence and Cautions
description: High-temperature cooking; acrylamide uncertainty; glycemic load; very hot drinks; coffee; GM, irradiated food, microwave, supplements and detox claims

name: Lifestyle Biological Pathways
description: DNA damage; acetaldehyde; oxidative stress; inflammation; hormonal/metabolic/immune and microbiome pathways; tobacco-alcohol and alcohol-hepatitis interactions

name: Lifestyle Risk Summary
description: Combine assessed lifestyle and exposure factors to inform risk-aware screening and clinical review

name: Post-Treatment and Restaging
description: yTNM after specified preoperative treatment; rTNM for recurrence; retain original diagnosis stage

name: Stage Subdivisions and SEER Extent
description: IIA/IIB; IIIA/IIIB/IIIC; SEER In situ, Localized, Regional, Distant and Unknown

name: Staging Investigations
description: Physical examination; CT; MRI; ultrasound; PET/PET-CT; endoscopy; biopsy and selected laboratory tests

name: Alternative Staging Systems
description: Lugano for selected lymphomas; FIGO for female reproductive cancers; conventional TNM may not apply to leukemia or many brain/CNS tumours

name: Grade Profile and Prognosis
description: Stage is anatomical extent; grade is differentiation; profile includes histology, biomarkers and molecular/genetic features; stage is not individual prognosis

name: Cancer-Specific Staging Caution
description: Stage 0 and TNM groupings are cancer-specific; map M1 to Stage IV only where the applicable cancer-specific system defines it

name: Multidisciplinary Treatment Planning
description: Stage, profile/grade, patient factors and preferences guide surgery, radiation, chemotherapy, immunotherapy, targeted/hormone/systemic therapy and supportive or palliative care

name: Surgical Specimen Available for Pathological Staging?
description: pTNM is considered only when adequate surgical and pathological information is available

name: Surgical Pathology Review
description: Review resection specimen primary tumour and regional nodes to support pathological TNM where applicable
